    if n == 0:
        return 0
    base = 0
    count = 0
    while base * 10 + 1 <= n:
        base = base * 10 + 1
        count += 1
    option1 = count * (n // base) + compute(n % base)
    option2 = count + 1
    n = 10 * base + 1 - n
    option2 += count * (n // base) + compute(n % base)
    return min(option1, option2)

number = int(input())
